nameEn: Manufacture of agricultural and forestry machinery
description: This class includes the manufacture of machinery used in agriculture, horticulture, forestry, and related activities.
includes: manufacture of tractors used in agriculture and forestry
manufacture of ploughs, scarifiers, cultivators, harrows, hoes, rakes
manufacture of seed drills and planters
manufacture of fertilizer distributors and manure spreaders
manufacture of harvesting and threshing machinery: combine harvesters, forage harvesters, straw and fodder balers
manufacture of hedge trimmers, brush cutters, powered lawnmowers
manufacture of poultry-keeping machinery, bee-keeping machinery, equipment for preparing animal feed
manufacture of machinery for cleaning, sorting or grading eggs, fruit or other agricultural produce
excludes: manufacture of non-powered agricultural hand tools, see 2593
manufacture of draining machinery for agriculture, see 2813
manufacture of industrial food processing machinery, see 2825
